rationale: For a Notion-style Idea Logger, we need authority, clarity, and function-first UI (Swiss). However, a purely stark black-and-white feels too brutalist for personal ideation. We integrate Archetype 1 (Organic & Earthy) for warmth—using a warm off-white background and subtle gray borders to reduce cognitive load and evoke a calm, paper-like writing environment.

layout_spacing.philosophy: Generous spacing. Bento Grids for larger canvases, Control Room density for the list views.

surfaces.list_item: border-b border-[#E5E5E3] py-4 hover:bg-[#F9F9F8] transition-colors cursor-pointer group
surfaces.card: bg-white border border-[#E5E5E3] rounded-lg shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200

buttons.primary: bg-[#1C1B1A] text-white px-4 py-2 rounded-md font-medium hover:bg-[#2C2B2A] transition-colors focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#E5E5E3] focus:ring-offset-2
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-[#1C1B1A] border border-[#E5E5E3] px-4 py-2 rounded-md font-medium hover:bg-[#F7F7F5] transition-colors
buttons.ghost: text-[#706F6C] hover:text-[#1C1B1A] hover:bg-[#F7F7F5] px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md transition-colors

inputs.default: w-full bg-white border border-[#E5E5E3] rounded-md px-4 py-2 text-base text-[#1C1B1A] placeholder:text-[#A09E9A] focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#D1D0CE] focus:border-transparent transition-all
inputs.search: w-full bg-[#F7F7F5] border-none rounded-full px-5 py-2.5 text-base text-[#1C1B1A] placeholder:text-[#706F6C] focus:bg-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#D1D0CE] transition-colors

components.tags: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium

icons.usage: Use stroke-width 1.5 for a delicate, refined look matching the Notion style.

images.description: Background texture is meant to be used at 10% opacity over the #F7F7F5 background if a textured feel is desired.

testing.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, list items) MUST have data-testid in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard HTML tags for layout and Shadcn components for complex interactions like Modals, Dropdowns, and Dialogs.
Do NOT use pure #000000 or #808080. Adhere strictly to the defined colors.
The Idea List should look clean and unboxed, similar to Notion's list view, using bottom borders to separate items instead of wrapping each in a heavy card.
Implement tags as small colored pills using the provided accent colors.
Maintain the layout with a left sidebar for categories and main content area for the list view.
Use framer-motion for smooth staggered list item entrance and layout animations on filtering.
Add 'lucide-react' for all iconography with strokeWidth={1.5}.
